name: Lynetteholm (new island, urban development and flood protection)
source_doc: Anlægsstatus 1H 2026 p. 37 (named as co-financier of Nordhavnstunnel)
notes: schematic corridor — not an official alignment. Rough reclamation area east of Refshaleøen (~2.8 km²), drawn by hand — By & Havn publishes no open-data boundary. No own budget or opening year in Anlægsstatus 1H 2026.

name: Nordhavn urban development
notes: schematic corridor — not an official alignment. Rough development area north of Nordhavn station, drawn by hand — By & Havn publishes no open-data boundary.

name: Nordhavnstunnel
notes: schematic corridor — not an official alignment. Svanemøllen to Nordhavn (Kattegatvej). Financed by Københavns Kommune, By & Havn and the future Lynetteholm I/S; prepared for an extension as Østlig Ringvej.

name: Hovedstadens Letbane, Ring 3 (Lyngby – Ishøj)
notes: Opened in stages 2025–2026. Not in Anlægsstatus 1H 2026 (own company, not a state construction project).

name: Den nye bane København–Ringsted
notes: Opened 2019; geometry is the Fingerplan 2019 centre-line reservation.

name: Ny bane over Vestfyn
notes: Anlægsstatus notes the total expenditure is not expected to hold ("Overholdelse af totaludgift: Nej").

name: Hastighedsopgradering Ringsted–Odense (200 km/t)
notes: schematic corridor — not an official alignment. Ringsted – Korsør – Nyborg – Odense, the existing line being upgraded to 200 km/t. Opening year in the report is "2028/2030" (Nyborg–Odense 2028, Ringsted–Korsør 2030).

name: Femern Bælt fixed link (Rødbyhavn – Puttgarden)
notes: earliest opening for road per Femern A/S 17 May 2026; rail undated; Anlægsstatus 1H 2026 says a new timetable is being prepared. Budget 55,100 mio. kr. is in 2015 prices, not the report's 2026 prices.

name: Danske landanlæg til Femern (Ringsted – Rødby)
notes: Budget 9.5 mia. kr. in 2015 prices. Phase 1 Ringsted–Nykøbing F. track done 2021, power/signalling 2027; phase 2 Nykøbing F.–Rødby 2028/at the latest 2029.

name: Storstrømsbroen (new road and rail bridge)
notes: schematic corridor — not an official alignment. Straight Masnedø – Orehoved crossing: OpenStreetMap has no way for the new bridge (only the old rail bridges tagged "Sydbanen"), so the status stays construction. Report gives "2026 (vej), 2027 (bane)"; original 2022 (road) / 2018 (rail).

name: Frederikssundsmotorvejen (reservation, Fingerplan)
notes: Motorway reservation in Fingerplan 2019, identified by location (runs from 2.2 km off Smørum north-west to 3.0 km off Frederikssund). Searched Anlægsstatus 1H 2026 for "Frederikssund", "Tværvej" and "3. etape": the only hit is an S-train mention on p. 17, so the report has no row for this project — status stays study and budget and opening year stay empty.

name: Udvidelse af Hillerødmotorvejens forlængelse til motorvej
notes: Geometry is the Fingerplan reservation Allerød–Hillerød (identified by location). Report: total expenditure not expected to hold.

name: Østlig Ringvej (harbour tunnel, København)
notes: Under study; Fingerplan 2019 marks the corridor as an ongoing investigation.

name: HH-forbindelsen (Helsingør–Helsingborg)
notes: Under study; no budget or opening year published.

name: Kattegatforbindelsen (Jylland–Sjælland)
notes: schematic corridor — not an official alignment. Kalundborg (Røsnæs) – Samsø – Hou/Odder, drawn to show the corridor under study. No alignment has been published.

name: Aarhus Letbane etape 2 (Brabrand)
notes: schematic corridor — not an official alignment. Aarhus H along Silkeborgvej to Brabrand/Gellerup. Decision expected 2027–28, opening 2037 per Aarhus Letbane; not in Anlægsstatus 1H 2026 and no alignment in OpenStreetMap.

name: Tredje Limfjordsforbindelse ved Aalborg
notes: Largest road project in the report by budget.

name: Ny tunnel under Marselis Boulevard, Aarhus
notes: Geometry indicative: the existing boulevard the tunnel follows.

name: Udvidelse af Amagermotorvejen

name: Signalprogrammet (new signalling, whole network)
notes: schematic corridor — not an official alignment. Nationwide programme with no single alignment; the line sketches the main line København – Odense – Fredericia – Aarhus – Aalborg only so the project is visible on a map. Largest project in the report by budget; report gives "2022/2033".
